cover.kicker: 封面故事 · GitHub 项目
cover.title:
Meta 的 astryx 连续两天
日增超过 3000 颗星
cover.dek: Meta 做的 agent ready 设计系统，基于 React 和 StyleX，带 CLI 和 MCP server，还在 beta。今天 +3039，昨天 +3335，冲高原因暂时没查清，可以先看看。
cover.title_en:
Meta's astryx tops 3,000
stars a day, two days running
cover.dek_en: Meta's agent-ready design system is built on React and StyleX, ships a CLI and an MCP server, and is still in beta. It gained 3,039 stars today after 3,335 yesterday. Nobody has pinned down why yet.

stickers.title: 官方 Skills
stickers.text: anthropics/skills 近 4 天日增从 415 一路升到 1,537，昨天创 30 周新高。
stickers.text_en: anthropics/skills climbed from 415 to 1,537 stars a day over four days, a 30-week high yesterday.

stickers.title: 论文角
stickers.text: ARCBench 发现保留规则的压缩运行，违规率比完整历史高出两倍以上。
stickers.text_en: ARCBench finds compressed runs that keep the rules violate them over twice as often as full history.

stickers.title: 遗忘代价
stickers.text: continual-harness-evolution 在新任务上进化后，旧任务 SWE-Bench 从 94.0% 掉到 32.0%。
stickers.text_en: After evolving on new tasks, continual-harness-evolution fell from 94.0% to 32.0% on old SWE-Bench tasks.
